blind.description: A stylized wooden lectern featuring a circular turned pedestal base, a carved wooden bookrest structure with gothic tracery cutouts on the side brackets, a hollow shelf beneath, and a thick closed book with a reddish-brown leather cover and ornate brass clasps resting on the slanted surface. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted stylized wood, leather, and metal textures.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rectangular wooden frame with corner posts holding a reddish-brown book secured with two golden clasps, with the circular wooden base slightly peeking out underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide.
